issues: Meaning drift: heading 'KEKERASAN BERBASIS GENDER DAN ANAK' translated as 'OF GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE AND CHILDREN' (should be 'Gender-Based Violence and Children/Child Violence' i.e., violence against children, not 'violence and children').

Meaning drift: several occurrences translate 'korban kekerasan berbasis gender dan anak' as 'victims of gender-based violence and children' instead of 'victims of gender-based violence and violence against children' / 'victims of gender-based violence and child violence'.
Meaning drift: item 3 Indonesian contains typo 'Againts'; translation silently corrects to 'Against' (should preserve source text content as given).
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 2: item 'l.' is merged into 'andl.' instead of appearing as a separate list item.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 3: item 'e.' is merged into the end of item 'd.' ('and e.') instead of appearing as a separate list item.

Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 4(1): sub-item 'a.' is merged into the end of the lead-in sentence ('right to:a.') and sub-item 'i.' is merged into the end of sub-item 'h.' ('andi.'). These must be separate list items to match the original structure.

Original Article 2 list item formatting error: "danl." indicates items k and l are merged; translation separates them into "k." and "l.", which changes the marker sequence compared to the source (must preserve markers as they appear).

Original Article 3 list item formatting error: "dan e." indicates items d and e are merged; translation separates them into "d." and "e.", which changes the marker sequence compared to the source (must preserve markers as they appear).

Original Article 4(1) has merged markers "berhak:a.", "dani."; translation normalizes into separate markers and adds indentation, which changes the exact marker sequence/boundaries required downstream.

Scrambled/merged list markers in several places: sub-items are run together (e.g., Article 5(1) a–f; Article 8 item f; Article 9 items h; Article 10 item b; Article 11 items b/e/f/g; Article 12 item c; Article 13 item d; Article 14 item k). Markers must appear once each and in order, with their content correctly associated.
Meaning drift in Article 16: 'dikoordinasikan oleh SKPD yang membidangi' means coordinated by the SKPD/agency in charge of the relevant field, not merely 'relevant SKPD' (needs clearer rendering).

Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 5: sub-items a–f are run together in the original ("...berkewajiban:a.", "danf."), but must appear as distinct list items in the translation; current translation adds formatting not mirrored by original markers (needs to preserve markers 1., 2., 3. and a.–f. in order).

Meaning drift in Article 6: original refers to "korban kekerasan berbasis gender dan anak korban kekerasan" (gender-based violence victims and child victims of violence); translation renders "victims of gender-based violence and children" which can imply children generally, not specifically child victims.

Meaning drift in Article 12(c): Indonesian states special legal protection for child victims may be carried out by appointing guardianship; English sentence is ungrammatical and risks misreading (needs to clearly express the conditional/may be carried out).

Minor meaning/term precision: "Peraturan Bupati" should be "Regent Regulation" (kept) but "Minimum Service Operational Standards" should reflect "Minimum Service Operational Standards"; ensure it is tied to Integrated Services (kept) and not reinterpreted. (No structural change, but ensure faithful phrasing).
